review1.text: "The riad recommendations were spot on, and the itinerary saved us so much guesswork. Marrakech felt easy to navigate from day one."
review1.author: — Claire, France

review2.text: "We used the interactive map to find hidden cafés in the medina. The desert camp suggestion for Merzouga was the highlight of our trip."
review2.author: — Daniel, Germany

review3.text: "Chefchaouen's blue streets were even more beautiful in person. Having a guide in Spanish made everything so much smoother."
review3.author: — Sofía, Spain
